checks.what: denmark-norway against swedish-empire, 1653-1659, winner Sweden, region Sweden (2,440 cells, the whole country; the ruling touches only conflict cells inside it). Roskilde page: concluded 26 February 1658 (O.S.; 8 March N.S.), with 'The immediate cession' of Scania, Blekinge, Halland and Bornholm, and of the Norwegian provinces of Bohuslän and Trøndelag. Halland had already been leased to Sweden for 30 years at Brömsebro in 1645. Against the current dossiers the ruling acts only in 1658, on 19 cells (19 cell-years): Kronoberg 8, Kalmar 3 and Värmland 4 (always Swedish), and Västra Götaland 4 (Dalsland, plus northern Bohuslän after Roskilde). All are correct, and nothing is harmed. The why's figures (40-85 cells, 250 cell-years, Dalarna 13, Västerbotten 10) came from the published compile. Dossier edits since then have removed the 1653 and 1656 conflicts and the Dalarna and Västerbotten strays (Dalarna 1 and Västerbotten 0 at 1 January 1650 in the trial), so the why overstated its effect. A control trial without the ruling differs only in these 19 cells in 1658.
checks.fix: The why is rewritten with the current figures and the Roskilde wording. Years, parties, winner and region are unchanged.

It must not cover the two Østfold cells at about 11.7 E 59.2-59.7 N.
